definitions.gloss: seat category; type of seating; seating class
definitions.explanation: A classification of seats by type, price, or location, used when purchasing tickets for concerts, sporting events, theaters, and transportation.

examples.japanese: {席種|せきしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{席種|せきしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are three seat categories for this performance.

examples.japanese: {席種|せきしゅ}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The price varies greatly depending on the seat category, so it's best to choose based on your budget.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (seat) and ⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ (type, kind). Commonly encountered on ticket purchasing websites and at box offices for events, concerts, and theaters. The term classifies seats by factors such as location (arena vs. balcony), view quality, and amenities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {席種|せきしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a seat category
- {席種|せきしゅ}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: pricing by seat type
- ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧{席種|せきしゅ}: all seat categories
- ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧{席種|せきしゅ}: designated seat type

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧: seat — refers to the physical seat itself, not the category
- ⟦{等級|とうきゅう}→等級：28928_toukyuu⟧: class, grade — broader term for ranking or classification, used for train classes (⟦グリーン{車|しゃ}→グリーン車：08489_guriinsha⟧) and hotel ratings
